sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:27149
Court No. - 76

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 606 of 2024
Applicant :- Shubham Kumar

Opposite Party :- State Of Up And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Danish,Rajiv Sisodia
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2.  Sri Ravi Kant Kushwaha, learned AGA for the State apprised the Court that he has received instructions in the present matter, therefore, the instant anticipatory bail application may be disposed of on merit.

3. Heard Sri Rajiv Sisodia, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ravi Kant Kushwaha, learned A.G.A. for the State.
4.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 1190 of 2023, under Section 409 IPC, Police Station Kotwali City, District Bijnor, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text:
FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and one other and according to the FIR,
applicant was the clerk in the State Food Corporation and from is office some files were missed but inspite of that applicant and another accused did not lodge FIR.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that totally on the basis of false allegation applicant has been made accused in the present matter and even if the allegations are accepted then also no criminal liability would be fastened and at worst it could be the dereliction of official duty.
7. He further submits that the investigation of the case is pending and police is trying to arrest the applicant.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submits, however, earlier applicant was also made accused in the case under Section 376 IPC but in that case applicant has already been acquitted on 27.08.2019.
8. Per contra, learned A.G.A. however, opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but could not dispute the arguments on the facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
9. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.
10. However, it appears that earlier also applicant was made accused in the case under Section 376 IPC but in that case he had already been acquitted by the trial court on 27.08.2019.

11. Therefore, considering the nature of the allegation and the fact that applicant is a public servant,
in my view applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till conclusion of trial.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

15. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
